project-grid.title: DevFlow
project-grid.description: A real-time collaborative code review platform built with Next.js 14, Socket.io, and PostgreSQL. Teams can annotate pull requests, run inline comments, and resolve threads without leaving the browser.

project-grid.title: VaultPass
project-grid.description: A zero-knowledge password manager with end-to-end AES-256 encryption. All secrets are encrypted client-side before hitting the server — the backend never sees plaintext.

project-grid.title: ShipMetrics
project-grid.description: SaaS analytics dashboard for e-commerce sellers tracking orders, revenue, and fulfillment KPIs in real time. Integrates with Shopify and WooCommerce via webhooks.

project-grid.title: ThreadCast
project-grid.description: A Twitter/X thread scheduling and analytics tool. Compose multi-tweet threads with a rich editor, schedule them, and track impressions, clicks, and follower growth over time.

project-grid.title: OpenCart AI
project-grid.description: An open-source headless e-commerce starter with an AI-powered product recommendation engine. Plug in your product catalog and get personalized upsell suggestions out of the box.

project-grid.title: PingBoard
project-grid.description: A lightweight uptime monitoring service that checks your endpoints every 60 seconds and sends Slack or email alerts on downtime. Includes a public status page generator.

project-grid.title: LexiForm
project-grid.description: A dynamic form builder with conditional logic, multi-step flows, and response analytics. Forms are rendered from a JSON schema, making them fully embeddable via a script tag.

project-grid.title: CloudNotes
project-grid.description: A Markdown-first note-taking app with real-time sync across devices, tag-based organization, and full-text search powered by a custom inverted index.

project-details.title: DevFlow
project-details.problem: Code review context gets lost across Slack threads and GitHub comments.
project-details.solution: A unified real-time workspace where reviewers and authors co-annotate diffs live.
project-details.outcome: Reduced average review cycle time by ~40% in beta teams of 5–12 engineers.

project-details.title: VaultPass
project-details.problem: Most password managers trust the server with your secrets.
project-details.solution: Client-side encryption using the Web Crypto API means the server stores only ciphertext — a breach exposes nothing.
project-details.outcome: Passed independent security audit with zero critical findings.

project-details.title: ShipMetrics
project-details.problem: Shopify's native analytics lack cross-channel revenue attribution.
project-details.solution: A webhook-driven ingestion pipeline normalises orders from multiple storefronts into a single Postgres schema with pre-aggregated views.
project-details.outcome: Onboarded 3 paying beta merchants within 2 weeks of launch.

project-details.title: OpenCart AI
project-details.problem: Adding personalised recommendations to a headless store requires expensive third-party SDKs.
project-details.solution: A self-hosted FastAPI microservice that computes collaborative-filtering recommendations from order history.
project-details.outcome: 220+ GitHub stars in the first month; adopted by 15 community forks.

Integrated Stripe billing, built an onboarding flow that improved activation rate by 34%, and set up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
